title: VPC version migration safeguard and staged handoff automation
creator: Connor Hayes
description: Implement a Terraform-first upgrade orchestration that provides a guarded, staged promotion path for control-plane versions in Private (VPC) deployments. Deliverables: reusable Terraform modules to create "shadow" control-plane stacks, an automated canary promotion pipeline that advances cohorts of tenants, an observable health-gating service that evaluates contract, performance, and resource signals, and a rollback-safe handoff playbook. The goal is to reduce manual toil during Private control-plane upgrades and eliminate ad-hoc tenant-by-tenant operations while preserving tenant isolation and data safety.
acceptance_criteria: A Terraform module (private_upgrade_shadow) that can instantiate a shadow control-plane in the same VPC with isolated state using standard module inputs (version, tenant_filter, instance_class) and produces a stable endpoint for canary validation.

A pipeline (GitHub Actions / Concourse) that performs: terraform plan -> terraform apply (shadow) -> synthetic smoke tests -> metrics gating -> progressive promotion to production control-plane per configurable cohort percentages.

Health gating rules enforced by the gating service, with at least three independent signals: API contract tests, end-to-end smoke latency and error checks, and infra resource health (CPU/Memory/Disk). Rules configurable per release and exported to release-2026.04.

Automatic rollback triggers documented + implemented: if any gating rule breach persists > 5 minutes during promotion, the promotion pauses and runs an automated rollback plan with clear operator steps in the runbook.
A runbook (playbook link) for on-call and SRE to follow for manual intervention, escalation, and postmortem templates.
No terraform state drift after shadow run; terraform plan against production after final promote shows no unintended diff for control-plane resources.
Security review completed and KMS/HSM key handling validated for control-plane secrets in shadow and promoted stacks.
notes: Design decision: prefer shadow stacks over in-place rolling upgrades for first rollout to minimize blast radius when operator CRD changes are involved.

We will use a tenant-filter strategy for cohorting (tenant labels in operator CRDs) instead of percentage-based traffic slicing at the network layer for initial pilot to avoid complex L4 traffic plumbing.
KV cache migration: include a validation job that compares cache hit/miss ratios between old/new control-plane for identical synthetic sessions (non-destructive).
Observability: dashboard templates (prometheus/grafana) created to display promotion metrics: promotion_progress, gating_errors, api_contract_failures, p95_latency_compare, token_errors_by_tenant.
Security: shadow control-plane uses ephemeral service account with read-only access to customer metadata; elevated secrets only injected during canary validation windows via sealed-secrets flow.
